g.text: Splitwise: split strategies behind one interface, and debt simplification collapsing raw IOUs into minimal transfers
Left: the class shape, strategies swappable behind SplitStrategy. Right: why net balances beat raw pairwise IOUs.
UPDATE balances SET amount = amount + ? WHERE user_pair = ?
atomic at the row -- not read-then-write in app code
New split type ("by shares"/weighted) = one new class here.
computeSplits() signature and recordExpense() never change.
Before: 3 expenses create 6 raw pairwise IOUs, not net amounts
6 edges to track -- and it only gets worse as expenses pile up
Net balance per user (this is all that actually matters):
Greedy settle-up: match the biggest debtor to the biggest creditor,
transfer min(|debt|,|credit|), drop whichever hits zero, repeat.
Alice needed zero transactions despite being in 3 of the raw IOUs.
